description.value:
Devaronians are a horned, sharp-featured humanoid species from the volcanic world of Devaron, known throughout the galaxy for their restless wanderlust and their striking sexual dimorphism — males possess prominent curling horns and a fierce visage, while females are smooth-skinned and often go unrecognized as members of the same species.

Devaronian culture prizes travel and new experience above nearly everything else; many Devaronians leave home as soon as they are able and never look back.

traits.name: Horns
traits.description: Devaronian males possess sharp horns that serve as natural weapons. If you have horns, you can use them to make unarmed strikes; if you hit with them, you deal 1d4 + your Strength modifier piercing damage instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.

traits.name: Nomadic Nature
traits.description: You are proficient in the Survival skill, reflecting a lifetime spent on the move across unfamiliar worlds.

traits.name: Silver Tongue
traits.description: You have advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made against creatures who have not met a Devaronian before.
